note: Source of truth for the Semester 1 final mark from 10 November 2026. A test keeps grader/continuous_assessment.py and grader/gradebook.gs in step with this file.

assignments.rule: All five count equally. Each is scaled to 4, so the component is the sum of the five marks divided by 5, out of 20. A missing or not-yet-marked item scores 0.

quizzes.rule: All five count equally. Each is scaled to 4, so the component is the sum of the five marks times 4/5, out of 20. A missing or not-yet-marked item scores 0.

engineering_ml_project.rule: Part A (30) plus Part B (15), 45 raw, scaled to 40. Counts only when BOTH parts are marked; until then the project is PENDING and the semester result is provisional out of 60.

quizzes: Q13 (gradebook columns) and the Week 8 to 11 block quizzes
assignments: A12 (gradebook columns) and the Week 8 to 11 block assignments
other: best-3-of-5 rule and the Week 6 waiver (retired: all five of A1 to A5 and Q1 to Q5 count)
not_counted.kept: Receipts for items that do not count are still collected and kept in the ledger; they simply add nothing to the final mark.

provisional.text: Semester 1 provisional: x of 60 marks, y percent

rounding: Each component is rounded to two decimal places, halves upward (Math.round(x*100)/100); the total is the rounded sum of the rounded components.
bands: No letter grades: Faculty grade bands have not been verified.
